100-kagiz-2015: "100 kağız" (100 Notes) is a comedy made by director Şahin Zəkizadə in 2015. Its main plot is built around a hundred-manat banknote. It stars Valeh Kərimov, Cəfər Namiq Kamal, Naibə Allahverdiyeva, Dilarə Əliyeva, Nicat Kazımov and Pərviz Məmmədrzayev.
100000-azn-2009: "100000 AZN" is a feature-length television film made by director Cavid Təvəkkül in 2009 and produced by Public Television. The events of the film take place mostly in a restaurant. It stars Rövşən Kərimduxt, İqrar Salamov, Kərəm Hadızadə, Asif Rəhimov, Tural Ağayev and Cümşüd Zeynalov.
1001-ci-qastrol-1974: "1001-ci qastrol" (The 1001st Tour) was made by director Oqtay Mirqasımov in 1974 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film revue argues that true talent cannot be destroyed; and conversely, if you have no voice, you will get nowhere. It stars Rəşid Behbudov, İnarə Quliyeva, İnna Leşşinskaya, Liya Eliava and Mavr Pyasetski.
16-2012: "16+" was made by director Məzahir Haşımov in 2012 and produced at "Milli production". The film is about first love: at its heart are the feelings a young man has for the woman next door. It stars Təhminə Məmmədova and Zaur Rəşidov. The film is the course work of director Məzahir Haşımov, a student at VGIK. In 2013 it was shown at the Kemerovo International Festival of Short and Animated Films.
21-sual-2017: "21 sual" (21 Questions) is a feature film made by director Ələkbər Əliyev in 2017 and produced at "Glad production". Our hero is a man who has not found himself in life and does not know what he wants from women. At last he meets the ideal woman he has been looking for all his life, and that is when the real "movie" begins. It stars Taleh Yüzbəyov, Aytən Əlizadə, Sərdar Gözəlov, Ziyad Qurbanov, Rəşid Əliyev, Allahverdi Yolçuyev and Fatma Mahmudova.
220-o-li-otaq-2010: "220 №-li otaq" (Room No. 220) is a short television film made by director Ruslan Hüseyni in 2010 and produced by Public Television. It stars Amid Qasımov, Oktay Mehdiyev, Cəlal Qurbanoğlu and Aynur Abbasova.
26-komissar-1932: "26 komissar" (26 Commissars) was made by director Nikolay Şengelaya in 1932 at the Azərfilm film studio. The historical-revolutionary film tells of the lives and revolutionary work of the Baku commissars, their efforts to build a commune in Azerbaijan, and the commune's fall. It stars Kazım Həsənov, Xeyri Əmirzadə, Əlisəttar Məlikov, İvan Klyukvin, Vasili Kovrigin, N. Kulikov, Allahverdi Məlikov and Veriko Ancaparidze.
3-badam-1-qoz-2017: "3 badam 1 qoz" (3 Almonds 1 Walnut) is a feature film made by director Rafael Bağıroğlu in 2017. The first film in Azerbaijan shot in the black comedy genre, it stars Mənsur Şərif, Rəsul Abbas, Sabir Samiroğlu, Altun Mətləboğlu, Cəmilə Tağızadə, Nigar Babayeva, Mila Əminə, Sevinc Şirinova and Rövşən Kərimduxt.
36-kadr-1996: "36 kadr" (36 Frames) is a short television film made by director Rövşən İsgəndərov in 1996 and produced by the "Sabah" creative association. It stars Səbinə Minasazova, Kamran Şahmərdanov and Kamran Əhmədov. The film depicts the last day of a sensitive photographer devoted to his craft.
40-ci-qapi-2008: "40-cı qapı" (The 40th Door) was made by director Elçin Musaoğlu in 2008 and produced at "Ritm Production" with the support of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the Republic of Azerbaijan. The film is about the fate of a 14-year-old boy (Həsən Səfərov). It stars Həsən Səfərov, Rövşən Ağayev, Gülər Nəbiyeva, Elmira Şabanova and Rafiq Əzimov.
44-2026: "44" is an Azerbaijani feature-length war drama made in 2026. It is dedicated to the 44-day Second Karabakh war of 2020. It was directed by İsmayıl Səfərəli and Maksim Smetana and written by Anar Ələkbərov and İsmayıl İman. The film was made with the support of the Ministry of Culture, the Cinema Agency of the Republic of Azerbaijan (ARKA) and the Baku Media Centre.
72-km-2014: "72 km" is a short film made by director Səmimi Fərhad in 2014 and produced at "Nano Group Production". The film is dedicated to the 22nd anniversary of the occupation of the Lachin district. It stars Eldar İmanov, Türkay Cəfərli, Lətifə Əliyeva, Tofiq Bayramov and Ağalar Bayramov.
777-o-li-is-1992: "777 №-li iş" (Case No. 777) was made by director Ceyhun Mirzəyev in 1992 at the "Mozalan" studio. As in "Mozalan", the heroes of this satirical-humorous film are once again bunglers, bribe-takers, bureaucrats, swindlers and the like. It stars Səyavuş Aslan, Yaşar Nuri, Ramiz Əzizbəyli, Eldəniz Zeynalov, İlham Namiq Kamal, Muxtar Maniyev and Rasim Balayev.
9x9-2013: "9x9" is a short film made by director Radmila Gordic in 2013. It was co-produced by Italy ("Torre") and Azerbaijan (the Nərimanfilm film studio). The film is about the fate of an architect, and an architect's fate is a different fate altogether: he often has to spend all his talent and passion creating spaces he will never live in himself. "9x9" follows our architect's journey from his home to his office. Rüstəm Şəfiyev appears in the film as the architect's shadow.
abbasin-bedbextliyi-1935: "Abbasın bədbəxtliyi" (Abbas's Misfortune) is a short animated film made by director D. Dikaryov in 1935 and produced at Azərfilm. It is based on motifs from Azerbaijani folk tales. It is the first animated film made in the Muslim world, and with it Azerbaijan also became the second country in the USSR to produce an animated film.
abseron-ritmleri-1970: "Abşeron ritmləri" (Absheron Rhythms) is a feature-length musical television film made by director Eldar Quliyev in 1970 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film is a creative report by masters of the arts to the working people of Azerbaijan. In it, to the sound of music, viewers set out to see Baku and get to know new works by Azerbaijani composers.
acilar-bitmez-2009: "Acılar bitməz" (The Pain Never Ends) was made by director Sərxan Kərəmoğlu in 2009 and produced at SK Production. The film tells the unhappy love story of Orxan (Sərxan Kərəmoğlu) and Mehriban (Qənirə Aslanova). It stars Sərxan Kərəmoğlu, Amaliya Pənahova, Hülya Korel, Məlahət Abbasova, Qənirə Aslanova, Halil Ergün, Sədayə Mustafayeva, Məmmədəli Balayev, Əhəd Hacıyev, Pərvanə Qurbanova and Yaşar Nuri.
ad-gunu-1977: "Ad günü" (Birthday) is an Azerbaijani film made by director Rasim Ocaqov in 1977. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio, commissioned by Central Television (Moscow). The lyrical-psychological film is about true friendship; it could also be called "A Conversation About a Friend". Its heroes are our contemporaries: people of different characters and different outlooks. The film touches on moral and ethical questions and explores the richness of our contemporaries' inner world.
ad-gunu-1992: "Ad günü" (Birthday) is a short animated film made by director Firəngiz Qurbanova in 1992 and produced at the "Birlik" studio. On Kürə's birthday, Yaramaz comes to visit, causes mischief and spoils everyone's mood.
adam-2010: "Adam" (A Man) is a short film shot by director Şamil Mahmudbəyov in 1996. It was completed in 2010 at the "Yeni dalğa" producer centre, commissioned by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the Republic of Azerbaijan. Through the figure of old Əhməd, the film portrays the problem of loneliness. It is about people's indifference and faithlessness towards one another. It stars Arif Kərimov, Ruslan Nəsirov, Rahib Əliyev, Arif Qasımov, İdris Rüstəmov, Bəhram Bağırzadə, Elxan Quliyev, Yuri Rjov, Zilli Namazov and Sona Quliyeva.
adam-ol-2-2006: "Adam ol! 2" (Behave Yourself! 2) is a feature film made by director Sərxan Kərəmoğlu in 2006 and produced at SK Production. The film tells of what happens to a producer named Sərxan (Sərxan Kərəmoğlu). He makes a girl named Vəfa (Vəfa Zeynalova) a famous singer, but nothing goes the way he expected. Vəfa not only fails to appreciate his efforts but even denies them. Betrayed, Sərxan decides to leave show business.
adam-ol-2005: "Adam ol!" (Behave Yourself!) is a feature film made by director Vaqif Şərifov in 2005 and produced at SK Production. Leyli xanım (İlhamə Quliyeva) intends to marry a man younger than herself. But because he is married and hid it when they first met, their romance comes to nothing. It stars İlhamə Quliyeva, Səyavuş Aslan, Yaşar Nuri and Firəngiz Mütəllimova.
ademin-yaranmasi-1993: "Adəmin yaranması" (The Creation of Adam) was made by director Yuri Pavlov in 1993. The film story is about divine love. It was produced by the "Cavanşir Kamandar" film studio (Borchali) and the "Neva" film studio (Saint Petersburg). It stars Saulyus Balandis, Sergey Vinoqradov, İrina Metlitskaya, Anjelika Nevolina, Aleksandr Strijenov, Yuri Ovsyanko, İlya Şakunov and Aleksey Palçek.
adi-ehvalatlar-2000: "Adi əhvalatlar" (Ordinary Stories) was made by director Murad İbrahimbəyov in 2000. The comedy is about what happens to the electrician and fitter Vasili İvanoviç Myakişev (Vladimir Steklov). It stars Vladimir Steklov, Kristina Orbakayte, Lyudmila Polyakova, Sergey Nikonenko, Aleksey Jarkov, Sergey Rubeko, Yuri Mitrofanov, Yuri Nifontov, Yuri Çernov and Vladimir Bolşov.
afroditanin-qollari-1987: "Afroditanın qolları" (Aphrodite's Arms) is a short film made by director Davud İmanov in 1987 and produced at the "Debüt" studio. Its hero (Rafiq Əliyev) is a sculptor trying to make "Aphrodite's Arms". In the course of this work he feels the pain of betrayal himself and comes to understand his own mistakes. It stars Rafiq Əliyev, Olqa Zolotuxina, Muxtar Avşarov, Təvəkkül İsmayılov and Əliqulu Səmədov.
ag-atli-oglan-1995: "Ağ atlı oğlan" (The Boy on the White Horse) is a feature film made by director Ənvər Əbluc in 1995 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The military-patriotic film tells of a schoolboy who fights heroically alongside the grown-ups in the war against the Armenian invaders for the liberation of Karabakh. It stars Abbasqulu Əbluc, Sədayə Mustafayeva, Orxan Nadirov, Yaşar Nuri, Ruslan Nəsirov, Dilarə Nəzərova, Səidə Səfərova, Xumar Əhədova, Laləzar Mustafayeva and Elxan Quliyev.
ag-dunya-1995: "Ağ dünya" (White World) is a feature-length television film made by director Şahmar Qəribli in 1995 and produced at the "Sabah" Experimental Creative Association–Test Studio. At the centre of the psychological drama is mad Səməd. But though he is called mad, he is fairer, more conscientious and wiser than some who are sane. Because the film was made by combining three stories, it tells of the misfortunes of three separate families.
ag-qan-2012: "Ağ qan" (White Blood) is a short film made by directors Xəyyam Abdullayev and Elməddin Alıyev in 2012 and produced at EXA Production. The film shows the life of a nomadic family whose farm has been ruined. It tells how the last wish of an old man on his deathbed (Vaqif Kərimov) is wisely carried out by his wife. It stars Svetlana Həkimova, Vaqif Kərimov, Bənövşə Əliyeva, Xanım Əliyeva, Şövqiyə Əliyeva, İlham Əlizadə and Nihad Əlizadə.
ag-qara-geceler-2013: "Ağ-qara" gecələr ("Black-and-White" Nights) is a feature film.
aganatiq-2-2021: "Ağanatiq 2" is a film made by director Cabir İmanov in 2021, produced by Planet Parni iz Baku Films. It stars Cabir İmanov, Bəhram Bağırzadə, Azər Məmmədzadə, Tahir İmanov, Ələkbər Əliyev and Tünzalə Ağayeva.
aganatiq-2017: "Ağanatiq" is a film made by director Cabir İmanov in 2017, produced by Planet Parni iz Baku Films. It stars Cabir İmanov, Bəhram Bağırzadə, Azər Məmmədzadə, Tahir İmanov, Ələkbər Əliyev and Tünzalə Ağayeva.
agir-skaf-1971: "Ağır şkaf" (The Heavy Wardrobe) is a short film made by director Cəmil Fərəcov in 1971 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The lead role is played by Elçin Məmmədov. The film is a lyrical sketch about the life of removal men. It is the course work of director Cəmil Fərəcov and cinematographer Azər Salayev.
aile: "Ailə" (Family) was made by directors Rüstəm İbrahimbəyov and Ramiz Həsənoğlu in 1998 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The social drama is devoted to the story of the break-up of a Baku family, as the "cell" of socialist society. It stars Həsənağa Turabov, Səyavuş Kərimi, Svetlana Metkina, Rafiq Əliyev, Təhminə Məmmədova, Nataliya Tağıyeva and Mehriban Zəki.
akinak-2026: "Akinak" is an Azerbaijani film produced in 2026.
aktrisa-2011: "Aktrisa" (The Actress) is an Azerbaijani film made by director Rövşən İsax in 2011. It was produced at the "Pozitiv Media" producer centre, commissioned by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of Azerbaijan. A crime drama, the film is about three murders committed one after another. It stars Fuad Poladov, Alesa Kaçer, İlham Hüseynov, Rövşən İsax and Şövqi Hüseynov.
aktrisanin-tebessumu-1974: "Aktrisanın təbəssümü" (The Actress's Smile) was made by director Rauf Kazımovski in 1974 and produced by Azerbaijan Television. The biographical film is dedicated to the actress Nəsibə Zeynalova. It stars Nəsibə Zeynalova, Lütfəli Abdullayev, İmamverdi Bağırov, Nəcibə Behbudova, Mobil Əhmədov, Əzizağa Qasımov, Məmmədsadıq Nuriyev, Ofeliya Aslan, Səyavuş Aslan and Hacıbaba Bağırov.
akvarium-1983: "Akvarium" (Aquarium) was made by director Firəngiz Qurbanova in 1983 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film touches on the protection of nature. The struggle for life and human sorrow are conveyed through skilfully used visual means. Əmir Tağıyev plays the child.
alma-almaya-benzer-1975: "Alma almaya bənzər" (Like Apple, Like Apple) is a lyrical comedy made by director Arif Babayev in 1975 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film calls on people to be honest and to respect one another, and shows that happiness lies only in honest work. It stars Hüseynağa Sadıqov, Fazil Salayev, Səfurə İbrahimova, Həsən Məmmədov, İnarə Quliyeva and Hacıbaba Bağırov.
alman-klinikasina-sexsi-sefer-1988: "Alman klinikasına şəxsi səfər" (A Private Trip to a German Clinic) was made by director Rasim İsmayılov in 1988 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The adventure film tells how, on the eve of the opening of the Genoa Conference, young Azerbaijani Chekists foil a sabotage operation prepared by oil magnates who had found refuge abroad after the revolution. It stars Ramiz Novruzov, İqor Ledoqorov, İqor Stepanov, Kazım Abdullayev, Yelena Tonunts, Liliya Makarova and Anatoli Kotenyov.
almanax-2013: "Almanax" is a short film made by director Eltun Baxışzadə in 2013, produced by Noize of Art. The film is the story of a writer who mixes up his dreams and reality. It stars Zaur Əliyarov, Fazil Əliyev, Fərrux Səlimxanlı and Cəmilə Ramazanova.
almaz-1936: "Almaz" is a feature film made by directors Ağarza Quliyev and Qriqori Braginski in 1936 at the Azerbaijan film studio. In this film story, Almaz, a young teacher who comes to work in a village, runs into obstacles and difficulties in the way of building and strengthening the new order there. It stars İzzət Oruczadə, Hökümə Qurbanova, Xeyri Əmirzadə, Əlisəttar Məlikov, Ələkbər Hüseynzadə and İsmayıl Hidayətzadə.
alo-bu-menem-2013: "Alo, bu mənəm" (Hello, It's Me) was made by director Nonna Müzəffərova in 2013 at the "Debüt" studio. It stars Sonaxanım Mikayılova, Abbas Qəhrəmanov, Mətanət Abbaslı and Rafiz Mehdizadə. The events of the film revolve around a robber who falls into "the pit he dug himself".
altinci-hiss-1935: "Altıncı hiss" (The Sixth Sense) is a feature film made by director Mikayıl Mikayılov in 1935 and produced at Azərfilm. The film is about the daily work and concerns of the people working in the republic's oil industry. It stars Ələsgər Ələkbərov, İ. Daşdəmirov, Ələkbər Hüseynzadə, İsmayıl Hidayətzadə, Möhsün Sənani and S. Klimov.
ana-ucun-agla-2013: "Ana üçün ağla" (Cry for Mother) is a short film made by director Emil Quliyev in 2013, produced by the "Art Film Pictures" company. Its subject is irresponsible fathers and unscrupulous mothers. It stars Natali Borzitski and Turqay Manafov.
analar-ve-laylalar-1991: "Analar və laylalar" (Mothers and Lullabies) is a short animated television film made by director Vaqif Behbudov in 1991 and produced at "Azərbaycantelefilm". It is a puppet film. Babies are a gift of nature. A mother sitting by the cradle and singing is her first talk with her child about goodness. To mothers, all children are the same.
anam-agaca-cixib-1986: "Anam ağaca çıxıb" (My Mother Climbed a Tree) is an Azerbaijani short animated film made by director Firəngiz Qurbanova in 1986 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film shows a mother who has to tell her little daughter magical tales to get her to eat her porridge.
anin-qurulusu-1980: "Anın quruluşu" (The Structure of a Moment) was made by director Rasim İsmayılov in 1980. The television film is mainly about Ədhəm returning to his homeland and passing himself off there as an important man. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio, commissioned by Central Television (Moscow). It stars Məmməd Məmmədov, Hacı İsmayılov, Anna Kamenkova, Vladimir Etuş, Olqa Barnet, Aleksandr Şarovski and Elxan Quliyev.
anlamaq-isteyirem-1980: "Anlamaq istəyirəm" (I Want to Understand) was made by director Oqtay Mirqasımov in 1980 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio, commissioned by Central Television (Moscow). The film is a wistful story of ruined dreams, the bitter outcome of a struggle for happiness, and the unhappy love of two young people. The actress Həmidə Ömərova was awarded the Lenin Komsomol Prize for the role of Çinarə. It stars Revaz Çxikvişvili, Həmidə Ömərova, Mikayıl Kərimov, Mayya İsgəndərova, Həsən Məmmədov and Həsənağa Turabov. The film was dubbed at AZTV.
apatiya-2024: "Apatiya" (Apathy) is an Azerbaijani film released in 2024.
araqarisdiran-1987: "Araqarışdıran" (The Troublemaker) is a feature film made by director Yefim Abramov in 1987 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The events of the film take place mostly in a secondary school. It stars Nizami Musayev, Ayan Mirqasımova, Leyla Dziqraşvili and Hamlet Xanızadə.
arasdirin-1978: "Araşdırın!" (Investigate!) is a short film made by director Cahangir Mehdiyev in 1978. It is the director's course work, made while he was studying at VGIK. Fazil Salayev plays the lead.
arsin-mal-alan-1917: "Arşın mal alan" (The Cloth Peddler) is a feature film made by director Boris Svetlov in 1917. It was made from Üzeyir Hacıbəyov's operetta of the same name and produced by the "Filma" joint-stock company.
arsin-mal-alan-1945: "Arşın mal alan" (The Cloth Peddler) is an Azerbaijani feature film made by directors Rza Təhmasib and Nikolay Leşşenko in 1945 at the Baku Film Studio. It stars Rəşid Behbudov, Leyla Bədirbəyli, Ələkbər Hüseynzadə, İsmayıl Əfəndiyev, Münəvvər Kələntərli, Lütfəli Abdullayev, Fatma Mehrəliyeva and Rəhilə Mustafayeva.
arsin-mal-alan-1965: "Arşın mal alan" (The Cloth Peddler) was made by director Tofiq Tağızadə in 1965 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. It stars Həsən Məmmədov, Leyla Şıxlinskaya, Ağadadaş Qurbanov, Nəcibə Məlikova, Hacımurad Yegizarov, Xuraman Hacıyeva, Tələt Rəhmanov and Səfurə İbrahimova.
arvad-1916: "Arvad" (The Wife) is a feature film made by director Boris Svetlov in 1916 and produced by the "Filma" joint-stock company. It stars A. Polonski, P. Amiraqon, K. Piontkovskaya, Regina Lazareva and Y. İvanova.
arvadlar-erlerini-mensebe-nece-catdirirl: "Arvadlar ərlərini mənsəbə necə çatdırırlar" (How Wives Get Their Husbands Promoted) is a feature film made by director Boris Svetlov in 1916 and produced by the "Filma" joint-stock company. It stars Boris Svetlov, Y. Buranovskaya, A. D. Panova-Potyomkina, S. Şoloxova, A. Verner and Q. Kramer.
arxada-qalmis-gelecek-2004: "Arxada qalmış gələcək" (The Future Left Behind) is a feature film made by director Rüfət Əsədov in 2004 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. In 2004 Səməd, a mischievous boy living in a refugee camp, falls and loses consciousness, and finds himself in the past: in the 1990s, in the war zone, among the soldiers. There he becomes a witness to and a participant in their heroism. It stars Fuad Poladov, Ağamehdi Abidov, Azərin, Ömür Nağıyev, Abbas Qəhrəmanov, Pərviz Məmmədrzayev, Mikayıl Mikayılov and Leyla Şahvəliyeva.
arxadan-vurulan-zerbe-1977: "Arxadan vurulan zərbə" (A Blow from Behind) was made by director Arif Babayev in 1977 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. Its makers speak of the invincibility of the human will and of love for the homeland standing above all else. 17 million people in the USSR watched the film. It stars Şahmar Ələkbərov, Adil İsgəndərov, Yusif Vəliyev, Hamlet Xanızadə, Amaliya Pənahova, Akif Əli and Rasim Balayev.
arzular-arzular-1988: "Arzular... Arzular..." (Dreams... Dreams...) is a short animated film made by director Vahid Talıbov in 1988 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. It speaks of a person's natural striving towards some goal or ideal, and of how, if morals are corrupted, this striving and this dream can be spoiled too.
arzularin-ardinca-2015: "Arzuların ardınca..." (Following Dreams...) is a feature film made by director Ramil Ağasıyev in 2015. The melodrama is about the last months of a young man with cancer. It is the director's first major work. It stars Ziya Ağa and Zarina Qurbanova.
arzunu-yarat-1977: "Arzunu yarat" (Create Your Dream) is a short live-action and animated film made by director Firəngiz Qurbanova in 1977 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. This experimental animated film is about a clown's dreams.
asif-vasif-agasif-1983: "Asif, Vasif, Ağasif" is a feature film made by director Rasim İsmayılov in 1983 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film has a very compact plot made up of ordinary events of life. At its centre is a young family with three sons, Asif (Emil Pənahov), Vasif (Ramin Aslanov) and Ağasif (Hökümə Cəlilova), and the family's worries about bringing the children up. It stars Emil Pənahov, Ramin Aslanov, Hökümə Cəlilova, Məmməd Məmmədov, Şükufə Yusupova and Leyla Bədirbəyli.
askarsizliq-seraitinde-1986: "Aşkarsızlıq şəraitində..." (In the Absence of Openness...) was made by director Fərhad Yusifov in 1986 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. Large-scale embezzlement takes place under the management of a house-building plant. Salahov, head of the city construction department, stands up against it. The plant's management decides to get rid of him. It stars Çingiz Şərifov, Fərman Abdullayev, Nail Əliyev, Faiq Sücəddinov, Vyaçeslav Həsənov, Xerardo Kontreras, Dinarə Yusifova, Rasim Rəhimov and Bayandur Mehdiyev.
aslan-ve-iki-okuz-1970: "Aslan və iki öküz" (The Lion and the Two Oxen) is a short animated film made by director Ağanağı Axundov in 1970.
avqust-gelende-1984: "Avqust gələndə" (When August Comes) was made by director Gülbəniz Əzimzadə in 1984 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film is about how the teenage characters of 15-year-old Arif and his friends take shape and how they come to assert themselves. It stars Natiq Abdullayev, Şahmar Ələkbərov, Valeri Rıjakov, Dadaş Kazımov, Şükufə Yusupova and Ayan Mirqasımova.
axinla-asagi-2014: "Axınla aşağı" (Down the River) was made by director Asif Rüstəmov in 2014 at the Cəfər Cabbarlı "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio, commissioned by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the Republic of Azerbaijan. Əli is a rowing coach who lives in the town of Mingachevir. He gets on with neither his wife nor his teenage son. Meanwhile his girlfriend, a Polish woman who works with him, suggests they go abroad together. But then tragedy strikes Əli's family.
axirinci-asirim-1971: "Axırıncı aşırım" (The Last Pass) was made by director Kamil Rüstəmbəyov in 1971 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The events of this film novel take place in a mountain village in Azerbaijan in the first years of Soviet rule. It stars Həsən Məmmədov, Adil İsgəndərov, Məlik Dadaşov, Hamlet Xanızadə, Həsənağa Turabov, Şəmsi Bədəlbəyli, Tamilla Rüstəmova, Şahmar Ələkbərov, Əbdül Mahmudov and Sadıq Hüseynov.
axirinci-dayanacaq-2014: "Axırıncı dayanacaq" (The Last Stop) is a feature film made by director Fikrət Əliyev in 2014. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio from a screenplay by İlqar Fəhmi and Fikrət Əliyev. The film is about tragicomic events in an old people's home. An ironic comedy, it follows the life of a former colonel who ends up in the home. Having lost his money, the colonel begins to suspect his friends, and what happens to him after that makes him a laughing stock.
axirinci-namaz-1963: "Axırıncı namaz" (The Last Prayer) is a short film made by director Zeynəb Kazımova in 1963 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio.
axirinci-reys-1989: "Axırıncı reys" (The Last Run) is a short film made by director Fuad Şabanov in 1989 at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film is about a brave bus driver who sacrifices himself to save a girl in trouble. It stars Ötkəm İsgəndərov, Fikrət Məmmədov, İnqa Qarayeva, İlqar Məmmədov, Rada Sokolova, Alina Sokol, Valeri Hüseynov, İlya Pres, Nofəl Əfəndiyev and Azər Əliyev.
axirinci-yol-2016: "Axırıncı yol" (The Last Road) is a feature film made by director Emil Abdullayev in 2016, a joint production of Azad Azərbaycan Television and İlk Media. The adventure comedy follows an eventful episode in the lives of the "Bozbash Pictures" heroes Şəmi, Şöşü, Fəlakət, Şirin, Qılman and Ağsaqqal. It stars İlkin Həsəni, Ramil Babayev, Elşən Orucov, Azər Baxşəliyev, Nicat Rəhimov and İlkin Miskərli.
ay-brilliant-2015: "Ay brilliant" (Oh, Diamond) is a feature film made by director Kənan Mahmudov in 2015, produced by Azad Azərbaycan TV and İlk Media. The events of the film revolve around the five main heroes familiar from "Bozbash Pictures". It stars İlkin Həsəni, Ramil Babayev, Elşən Orucov, Azər Baxşəliyev, Nicat Rəhimov, Şamil Süleymanov and Pərvin Abıyeva.
ayaqqabi-emeliyyati-2016: "Ayaqqabı əməliyyatı" (Operation Shoe) is a short film made by director Pərviz Həsənov in 2016 and produced at the "Debüt" studio. The film is about what happens to the shoemaker Qədir. It stars Qurban İsmayılov, Rasim Cəfər, Almaz Amanova and Leyla Əbdülsəmədova.
ayaqyalin-mehebbet-1916: "Ayaqyalın məhəbbət" (Barefoot Love) is a short film made by director Boris Svetlov in 1916 and produced by the "Filma" joint-stock company. The comic sketch is about the lives of Baku's residents. Its events take place on the streets of Baku, on a ship and in a hotel. It stars A. Panova-Potyomkina, Regina Lazareva, Yevgeni Muromski and V. Lenin.
aygun-1960: Aygün is a feature-length television film made by director Kamil Rüstəmbəyov in 1960. It was produced at the Baku Television Studio. The story turns mainly on the relationship and fate of two young people who have just married. The leading roles are played by Nəcibə Məlikova, Həsənağa Salayev and Rəna Topçubaşova.
ayi-ve-sican-1970: Ayı və siçan (The Bear and the Mouse) was made by director Nazim Məmmədov in 1970.
ayna-2000: Ayna (The Mirror) is a short television film made by director Azər Zamanlı in 2000. It was produced by Azerbaijani television. The film is about a day in the life of a photographer who lives a simple life. The leading role is played by Arif Qasımov.
ayna-2006: Ayna (The Mirror) is a short animated film made by director Firəngiz Quliyeva in 2006. It was produced at Azanfilm. The film tells a humorous tale of what happens to forest animals who get hold of a mirror.
ayriliq-1995: Ayrılıq (Separation) is a short feature film made by director Elçin Cahangirli in 1995. It was produced by Azerbaijani television. The film is based on motifs from Əlfi Qasımov's novella "Qağayı fəryadı" (The Cry of the Gull). It tells of the fate of two young people who once loved each other. The leading roles are played by Nailə Əliyeva and Elçin Cahangirli.
ayriliq-imis-2008: Ayrılıq imiş (So It Was Parting) is a feature film made by directors Ağaəli Əliyev and Faiq Kərimoğlu in 2008. It was produced by the company İ. F. A. The film tells the life story of a singer named Orxan Hüseyn who comes from the provinces and becomes famous. The leading roles are played by İzzət Bağırov, Natəvan Həbibi and Mehriban Xanlarova.
aysel-2015: The anthology film Bakı, mən səni sevirəm (Baku, I Love You) was made in 2015. It was produced at the Mosfilm film concern with the support of the Heydar Aliyev Foundation. The anthology includes 10 short films: "Aziya", "Görüş", "Rəssam", "Həyət", "Bəhram Gur", "Lotereya bileti", "Xəzər Atlantidası", "Sevgi haqqında", "Aysel" and "Təsadüf". Each film in the project reflects a different moment of life in Baku.
azarkes-2008: Azarkeş (The Fan) is a feature-length television film made by director Cavid Təvəkkül in 2008. It was produced by Public Television. The film tells of what happens to a fanatical supporter of the Argentina football team. The leading roles are played by Əjdər Həmidov, Səidə Quliyeva and Kəmalə Hüseynova.
aziya-2015: The anthology film Bakı, mən səni sevirəm (Baku, I Love You) was made in 2015. It was produced at the Mosfilm film concern with the support of the Heydar Aliyev Foundation. The anthology includes 10 short films: "Aziya", "Görüş", "Rəssam", "Həyət", "Bəhram Gur", "Lotereya bileti", "Xəzər Atlantidası", "Sevgi haqqında", "Aysel" and "Təsadüf". Each film in the project reflects a different moment of life in Baku.
babamizin-babasinin-babasi-1981: Babamızın babasının babası (Our Grandfather's Grandfather's Grandfather), also known as Babamın babasının babası, is a comedy feature film made in 1981 by the Azerbaijani Soviet director Tofiq Tağızadə at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. Its main character is Əziz baba, a 160-year-old shepherd portrayed as the bearer of the ideas of love and eternity. The leading roles are played by Hüseynağa Sadıqov, Samir Qədirov, Şamil Süleymanov, Səməndər Rzayev, Hamlet Qurbanov, Həmidə Ömərova and Sabir Məmmədov.
babanin-nagili-2012: Babanın nağılı (Grandfather's Tale) is a feature-length television film made by director Bəhruz Qasımov in 2012. It was produced by "Türkel tv". On the eve of the Novruz holiday, a grandfather gathers the children around a bonfire and tells them comic tales about Novruz and Spring. The leading roles are played by Musa Eyyubov, Bəhruz Qasımov, Əminə Şahin, Aqil Seyfəli and Rəfael Rəvan.
babek-1979: Babək is a feature film made by director Eldar Quliyev in 1979. It is a joint production of the "Mosfilm" and "Azərbaycanfilm" film studios. The film is built around Babək's freedom movement. It is the most expensive film of the Azerbaijan SSR. The leading roles are played by Rasim Balayev, Həsənağa Turabov, Amaliya Pənahova, Tamara Yandiyeva, Şahmar Ələkbərov, Məmməd Verdiyev, Hamid Azayev and Ənvər Həsənov.
bag-movsumu-1985: Bağ mövsümü (Dacha Season) is a feature film made by director Tofiq Tağızadə in 1985. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. It tells an instructive story set in one of Baku's dacha settlements, about Ağababa (Həsən Məmmədov), an honest bus driver who lives by high moral standards, and his large family. The leading roles are played by Həsən Məmmədov, Zemfira Sadıqova, Səməndər Rzayev, Leyla Şıxlinskaya, Hacımurad Yegizarov, Nuriyyə Əhmədova, Ramiz Əzizbəyli, Yelena Seropova and Elxan Cəfərov.
bagcada-rahat-yer-1978: The anthology film Arvadım mənim, uşaqlarım mənim (My Wife, My Children) was made in 1978. It consists of 3 short film novellas: "Toy" (director: Nicat Feyzullayev), "Bağçada rahat yer" (director: Ziyafət Abbasov) and "Arvadım mənim, uşaqlarım mənim" (director: Cəmil Fərəcov). It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio, commissioned by Central Television (Moscow). The leading roles are played by Kazım Abdullayev, Hacı İsmayılov, Məlahət Salmanova, Həsən Məmmədov, Ofeliya Məmmədzadə, Şamil Süleymanov, Gülşən Qurbanova and Kamil Məhərrəmov.
bagisla-gele-bilmedim-2015: Bağışla, gələ bilmədim (Forgive Me, I Could Not Come) is a short feature film made by directors Faiq Kərimoğlu and Ramin Asimoğlu in 2015. The film depicts prisoners held in a dungeon near Karbala while Imam Hussein was there, and what happens after they hear the news of his martyrdom. The leading roles are played by Rasim Balayev, Namiq Ağayev, Kamran M. Yunis, Şamil Süleymanov and Təvəkkül Əliyev.
bagli-qapi-1981: Bağlı qapı (The Closed Door) is a feature film made by director Rasim Ocaqov in 1981. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The lyrical psychological drama tells of the complicated fate of a man who comes to others' aid and cares about their troubles. In 1982 the film received a diploma and a prize for the best feature film on a contemporary theme at the 15th All-Union Film Festival in Tallinn. The leading roles are played by Rodion Naxapetov, Nəsibə Zeynalova, Aleksandr Kalyagin, Dadaş Kazımov, Hacı İsmayılov and Larisa Xələfova.
bahar-eylenceleri-1989: Bahar əyləncələri (Spring Festivities) is a short animated film made by director Ağanağı Axundov in 1989. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio.
baharin-ogurlanmasi-2023: Baharın oğurlanması (The Theft of Spring) is an Azerbaijani animated film made in 2023.
baharin-soraginda-2011: Baharın sorağında (In Search of Spring) is a feature film made by director Musa Eyyubov in 2011. It was produced by "Türkel tv". The film is based on a tale told by the mythical figure Dədə Qorqud. The leading roles are played by Bəhruz Qasımov, Günel Rüstəmova, Xaqani Məmmədov, Arif Almədətov and Telli Abdullayeva.
baki-ogrusu: Bakı oğrusu (The Baku Thief) is a musical psychological thriller made by Anar Nağılbaz in 1997.
bakida-kulekler-esir-1974: Bakıda küləklər əsir (The Winds Blow in Baku) was made by director Muxtar Dadaşov in 1974. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The leading roles are played by Şahmar Ələkbərov, Həsən Məmmədov, Nikolay Fedortsev, Rza Təhmasib, Pavel Kadoçnikov, Aleksandr Afanasyev and Andrin İnqrid.
bakililar-1938: "Bakılılar" (The People of Baku) is a feature film made by director Viktor Turin in 1938. It was produced at Azərfilm. The film is devoted to the revolutionary events in Baku in 1905 and the struggle to overthrow tsarist absolutism. The leading roles are played by Rza Əfqanlı, Nikolay Şulgin, O. Kutıryeva, Boris Baykov, Vaso Qodziaşvili and V. Baqratuni. By Decision No. 211 of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Azerbaijan of 7 May 2019, the film was included in the list of films declared national property of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
bakinin-isiqlari-1950: Bakının işıqları (The Lights of Baku) is a feature film made by directors Aleksandr Zarxi, Rza Təhmasib and İosif Xeyfits in 1950. It was produced at the Baku Film Studio. The film is about Baku's oil workers. The leading roles are played by Mirzəağa Əliyev, Mərziyyə Davudova, Nikolay Oxlopkov, Rza Təhmasib and Nəcibə Məlikova.
balaca-coban-1985: Balaca çoban (The Little Shepherd) is a short animated film made by director Əsgər Məmmədov in 1985. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The animated film is about the lack of independence of a child brought up at home under the wing of his parents.
balaca-ev-2012: Balaca ev (The Little House) is a short animated film made by director Aleksandra Şirinova in 2012. It was produced at the "Azanfilm" animation studio. A dialogue takes place between an old library building and new buildings. They make fun of the old building and mock it. But the time comes when the little house is restored and serves people once again.
baliq-gunu-1983: Balıq günü (Fish Day) is a short feature film made by director Cəmil Quliyev in 1983. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The comedy tells a funny story of what happens to Əbdüləli (Arif Qasımov), a lover of fish. The leading roles are played by Arif Qasımov and Gülşən Qurbanova.
baliqcilar-1927: Balıqçılar (The Fishermen) is a short feature film made by director Rza Təhmasib in 1927. It was produced at "Azdövlətkino". The film tells of a fisherman's tragic life. The leading roles are played by Cəfər Cabbarlı and Ağarza Quliyev.
basatin-igidliyi-1988: Basatın igidliyi (The Valour of Basat) is a short animated television film made by director Vaqif Behbudov in 1988. It was produced at "Azərbaycantelefilm". In the film the wise Dədə Qorqud sees a young warrior's courage and gives him the name Basat. Basat defeats the wicked Təpəgöz and saves the children and mothers from disaster.
baslangic-1982: Başlanğıc (The Beginning) is a short animated television film made by director Vaqif Behbudov in 1981. It was produced by "Azərbaycantelefilm", commissioned by Central Television. The film speaks of the importance of preserving peace on earth. Through two characters, good and evil, it suggests that difficulties will be overcome and that it will be possible to live in peace and security.
bayqus-1924: Bayquş (The Owl) is a feature film made by director Georgi Kravçenko in 1924. It was produced at AFKİ. The film depicts the class struggle between different social strata in a village on the eve of the establishment of Soviet power in Azerbaijan, the greed of some clergy, and their deceiving of ordinary people under the cover of religion. The leading roles are played by Abbas Mirzə Şərifzadə, Ağarza Quliyev, Möhsün Sənani and Aleksandr Makovski.
bayqus-gelende-1978: Bayquş gələndə... (When the Owl Comes...) was made by director Şamil Mahmudbəyov in 1978. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The events of the lyrical psychological drama take place in one of the small summer settlements of Absheron, where the hero meets various people. The leading roles are played by Emin Qafarzadə, Fikrət Məmmədov, Həsənağa Turabov, Gülşən Qurbanova, Firəngiz Şərifova, İsmayıl Osmanlı, Vidadi Əliyev and Sevil Rəsulova.
bayramda-yagis-1985: Bayramda yağış (Rain on a Holiday) is a short feature film made by director Cəmil Quliyev in 1985. It was produced at the "Debüt" Studio. The film tells of the life of a "little" man, his loneliness and his estrangement from society. The leading roles are played by Arif Qasımov, Həmidə Ömərova and Tələt Rəhmanov.
bedbextliyin-astanasinda-1977: Bədbəxtliyin astanasında (On the Threshold of Misfortune) is a short feature film made by director Rauf Nağıyev in 1977. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The plot is built around a fire caused by negligence. The leading roles are played by Cəfər Namiq Kamal, Kamilə Tatlıyeva, Elmira Şabanova and Hicran Nəsirova.
behram-gur-2015: The anthology film Bakı, mən səni sevirəm (Baku, I Love You) was made in 2015. It was produced at the Mosfilm film concern with the support of the Heydar Aliyev Foundation. The anthology includes 10 short films: "Aziya", "Görüş", "Rəssam", "Həyət", "Bəhram Gur", "Lotereya bileti", "Xəzər Atlantidası", "Sevgi haqqında", "Aysel" and "Təsadüf". Each film in the project reflects a different moment of life in Baku.
bele-lazimdir-1982: Belə lazımdır (That's How It Should Be) is a short feature film made by director Vaqif Mustafayev in 1982. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. On one of life's ordinary, tedious days, the film's heroes look for and find a way out of their situation. How does that happen? That is what the film is about. The leading roles are played by Səməndər Rzayev, Səyavuş Aslan, Şükufə Yusupova and Hacı İsmayılov. In 1984, at the 4th All-Union Festival of Young Filmmakers in Moscow, the film was awarded a prize and a diploma for the best direction.
bes-deqiqe-2015: The anthology film Bakı gecələri (Baku Nights) was made in 2015. It was produced at the "Debüt" studio. The anthology includes 5 short films: "Yeraltı keçid", "Buludlar", "İşıq yolu", "Beş dəqiqə" and "Skripkaçı". The leading roles are played by Şahmar Qəribli, Svetlana Həkimova, Günel Məmmədova, Nicat Əli, Səbinə Məmmədova, Rafiz Mehdizadə, Vidadi Həsənov, Pərvin Abıyeva, Fəxrəddin Manafov, Mehriban Zəki, Dəniz Tacəddin, Günəş Mehdizadə, Şahin Səlimov and Rasim Cəfər.
bext-uzuyu-1991: Bəxt üzüyü (The Ring of Fortune) is a feature film made by director Ramiz Əzizbəyli in 1991. It was produced at the "Qara Qayafilm" studio. The film is built around the loss of Sara's (Gülşad Baxşıyeva) ring of fortune. The leading roles are played by Afaq Bəşirqızı, Valeh Kərimov, Gülşad Baxşıyeva, Ayşad Məmmədov, Firəngiz Rəhimbəyli, Nəsir Sadıqzadə and Rəfael Dadaşov. In 1993, at the 2nd festival-competition of Azerbaijani films in Baku, director Ramiz Əzizbəyli received the Audience Award.
bextever-1990: Bəxtəvər (Lucky One) is a short feature film made by director Ömür Nağıyev in 1990. It was produced at the "Debüt" studio. It is a wistful film story about the fate of an unlucky man with a very beautiful voice. The leading roles are played by Kamil Məhərrəmov and Mehriban Xanlarova.
bextiyar-1942: Bəxtiyar is a short feature film made by director Ağarza Quliyev in 1942. It was produced at the Baku Film Studio. The film novella tells of the heroism shown at the front by Bəxtiyar Kərimov, a soldier and brave son of the Azerbaijani people. The leading roles are played by Möhsün Sənani and Xeyri Əmirzadə.
bextiyar-1955: Bəxtiyar is a feature film made by director Lətif Səfərov in 1955. It was produced at the Baku Film Studio. The musical film tells of the fate of Bəxtiyar Muradov, an oil worker with a beautiful and unique voice. The leading roles are played by Rəşid Behbudov, Tamara Çernova, Faiq Mustafayev, Ağasadıq Gəraybəyli, Məmmədrza Şeyxzamanov and İsmayıl Əfəndiyev.
beyin-ogurlanmasi-1985: Bəyin oğurlanması (The Abduction of the Groom) is an Azerbaijani film made by Ceyhun Mirzəyev and Vaqif Mustafayev in 1985. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The leading roles are played by Həsənağa Turabov, Səyavuş Aslan, Hacı İsmayılov, Nəsibə Zeynalova, Yaşar Nuri, Natəvan Məmmədova, Tamara Şakirova and Şamil Süleymanov.
bir-addim-2009: Bir addım (One Step) is a short feature film.
bir-aile-1943: Bir ailə (One Family) is a feature film made by director Qriqori Aleksandrov in 1943. It was produced at the Baku Film Studio. The film speaks of the patriotism and friendship of people of different nationalities during the Second World War. The leading roles are played by Xosrov Məlikov, Mərziyyə Davudova, Lyubov Orlova, M. Jarikov and Antonina Filipova. By Decision No. 211 of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Azerbaijan of 7 May 2019, the film was included in the list of films declared national property of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
bir-ailelik-bag-evi-1978: Bir ailəlik bağ evi (A Dacha for One Family) is a feature film made by director Yuli Qusman in 1978. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film is based on motifs from writer Rüstəm İbrahimbəyov's play "Qum üzərində ev" (A House on the Sand). The leading roles are played by İqor Kvaşa, Firəngiz Şərifova, Larisa Xələfova, Süleyman Ələsgərov and Rasim Balayev.
bir-alcalmanin-tarixi-1919: Bir alçalmanın tarixi (The Story of a Downfall) is a feature film made by director Boris Svetlov in 1919. It was produced by the "Filma" joint-stock company. This sharp drama of contemporary life puts forward the idea that whatever befalls people is the decree of fate. The leading roles are played by A. Polonski, Regina Lazareva and Yevgeni Muromski.
bir-axsam-1985: Bir axşam... (One Evening...) is a short animated film made by director Firəngiz Qurbanova in 1985. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The events of the film take place in an ordinary room, before the eyes of an 8-year-old girl.
bir-az-da-bahar-bayrami-1979: Bir az da Bahar bayramı (A Little More Spring Holiday) is a short television film made by director Nazim Abbas in 1979. It was produced at "Azərbaycantelefilm". The film tells of the bitter fate of the PE teacher Məmmədəli. The leading roles are played by Tofiq Mirzəyev, Sona Aslanova, Adil İsmayılov and Çingiz Əhmədov.
bir-cenub-seherinde-1969: Bir cənub şəhərində (In a Southern Town) is a film by Eldar Quliyev, made by him in 1969. It is the first Azerbaijani film shot in the neorealist style, and Eldar Quliyev the first Azerbaijani director to make a film in that style. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The social film story brings to the fore how the remnants of the past are still rooted in people's minds, and how hard it is for a person to reach spiritual freedom.
bir-defe-1990: Bir dəfə (Once) is a short animated film made by director Vahid Talıbov in 1990. It was produced at the "Azanfilm" Studio. The film is a political satire about events of the late 1980s.
bir-mehelleden-iki-nefer-1957: Bir məhəllədən iki nəfər (Two from the Same Neighbourhood) is a feature film made by directors İlya Qurin and Əjdər İbrahimov in 1957. It is a production of the Baku Film Studio and the Maxim Gorky Film Studio. The film tells of the struggle of ordinary people for peace and independence in one of the countries of the East. The leading roles are played by Vadim Medvedev, Semyon Sokolovski, Fateh Fətullayev, İsmayıl Osmanlı and Tamara Kokova. In 1957, at the 1st All-Union Film Festival in Moscow, the composer Qara Qarayev received a prize for the film's music.
bir-nefer-hamiya-gore-1989: Bir nəfər hamıya görə (One for All) is a short feature film made by director Murad İbrahimbəyov in 1989. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film exposes the true face of a false leader. The leading roles are played by İqor Kostalevski, Mixail Filippov, Vladimir Yermolayev, Yelena Romanova and Aleksandr Şarovski.
bir-qalanin-sirri-1959: Bir qalanın sirri (The Secret of a Fortress) is a feature film made by director Əlisəttar Atakişiyev in 1959. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. The film tale tells of the struggle of poor but honest and proud people against a merciless, cruel ruler who has taken the people's land and water. The leading roles are played by Gündüz Abbasov, Tamara Kokova, Məmmədrza Şeyxzamanov, Əli Qurbanov, Andrey Fayt and Əli Zeynalov.
birceciyim-1986: Bircəciyim (My Only One) is a feature film made by director Ənvər Əbluc in 1986. It was produced at the "Azərbaycanfilm" film studio. sifarisci-2000: "Sifarişçi" (The Client) is a film by Elnur Mehdiyev from a screenplay by Natiq Rəsulzadə.
